bitcoin_articles.headline: Sterling Digital PLC Announces West Texas Mining Site is Fully Operational
bitcoin_articles.summary: Sterling Digital plc has confirmed that its Bitcoin mining facility in West Texas is now fully operational.

bitcoin_articles.headline: H100 Group Partners with Coinbase to Bolster Balance Sheet
bitcoin_articles.summary: H100 Group AB has entered into a partnership with Coinbase to support its corporate strategy of accumulating Bitcoin on its balance sheet.
